rule: primary = highest worst-fold ROI (2023/24, 2024/25) among variants with >= 300 bets on each fold

primary.name: G7 EV>0 (meta-model)
primary.definition: Main = A; stake if EV with the inner logistic meta-model probability > 0 (groups seen in training)

secondary.name: B3 selection-conditional
secondary.definition: isotonic map fitted on the inner season's Main picks of A only; rule A on it

secondary.name: C2 value first EV>=0
secondary.definition: rule A, first among priced candidates with EV >= 0

secondary.name: E2 candidate-count penalty
secondary.definition: rule A on p - lambda x log(number of candidates), lambda fitted on the inner season

secondary.name: F1 blend Shin (inner weight)
secondary.definition: rule A on w p + (1 - w) q_Shin(price of the selection's market), w per group by inner log loss

baseline.name: A
baseline.definition: main_prediction() with the production constants (src/config.py MAIN_*, MARKET_RELIABILITY)

preregistered.fitting_for_2026_27: every fitted component (calibration maps, blend weights, meta-model, lambda, dropped groups) is fitted on 2025/26 predicted by the models trained on < 2025/26 (walk-forward), bettable universe with Football-Data Bet365 prices; nothing is fitted on 2026/27

universes_2026_27.V1 (primary): production store: latest pre-kick-off version of every 2026/27 match of the unified history; candidates = every selection with a recorded price or, if none, the last OddsPapi archive quote strictly before kick-off; matches with priced 1X2 and total 2.5; q = de-margined price of the same market (Shin) where all its selections are priced
universes_2026_27.V2 (like for like): the same 2026/27 matches and model probabilities, but only the Football-Data markets (1X2, total 2.5, the Asian line) at Football-Data Bet365 opening prices
universes_2026_27.blend weights outside the fitted groups: double chance uses the 1X2 weight; BTTS and corners the totals weight (transforms.BLEND_GROUPS)

preregistered.adoption: production changes only if the primary passes rules 1–3 on the folds AND rule 4 on 2026/27 V1

definitions.A: main_prediction() with the production constants (src/config.py MAIN_*, MARKET_RELIABILITY)
definitions.B1 isotonic: per-key isotonic map (group|side) of the no-refund probability fitted on the inner season; rule A on the calibrated probability
definitions.B2 Platt: per-key logistic map of logit p fitted on the inner season; rule A on it
definitions.B3 selection-conditional: isotonic map fitted on the inner season's Main picks of A only; rule A on it
definitions.C2 value first EV>=0: rule A, first among priced candidates with EV >= 0
definitions.C2 value first EV>=0.03: rule A, first among priced candidates with EV >= 3 %
definitions.C3 max EV: priced candidate in the band 0.40–0.85 with the highest EV (raw p)
definitions.C5 calibrated max EV: highest EV with the B1 probability
definitions.D3 drop over-confident groups: rule A without groups whose inner-season A picks were > 2 pp over-confident (>= 100 picks)
definitions.E1 lower confidence bound: rule A on (B1 probability - standard error of the inner hit rate of its key and 0.05 bin)
definitions.E2 candidate-count penalty: rule A on p - lambda x log(number of candidates), lambda fitted on the inner season
definitions.F1 blend Shin (inner weight): rule A on w p + (1 - w) q_Shin(price of the selection's market), w per group by inner log loss
definitions.F5 blend Pinnacle: as F1 with Pinnacle prices (folds only)
definitions.G1 EV>0 (raw): Main = A; stake if raw EV > 0
definitions.G2 EV>5% (raw): Main = A; stake if raw EV > 5 %
definitions.G3 EV>0 (calibrated): Main = A; stake if EV with the B1 probability > 0
definitions.G4 EV>3% (calibrated): Main = A; stake if EV with the B1 probability > 3 %
definitions.G5 EV>0 (blend): Main = A; stake if EV with the F1 probability > 0
definitions.G6 EV>2% (blend): Main = A; stake if EV with the F1 probability > 2 %
definitions.G7 EV>0 (meta-model): Main = A; stake if EV with the inner logistic meta-model probability > 0 (groups seen in training)
definitions.G9 agrees with market (|p-q|<3pp): Main = A; stake if |p - q_Shin| < 3 pp
definitions.G10 odds 1.60–2.50: Main = A; stake if the price is in 1.60–2.50
definitions.G11 F1 Main, EV>0 (blend): Main = F1; stake if EV with the F1 probability > 0
